newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Port conditions update - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
Bangladesh, March 10 - Chittagong, no berthing delay for general cargo vessels.

Pakistan, March 11 - Karachi, ten vessels waiting off port, comprising one general cargo vessel waiting two days, one container vessel waiting one day, three fertiliser vessels, first waiting 16 days, one loader waiting two days and four oil tankers, first waiting four days. Three other vessels laid up off port for their own reasons.
